_comment: Divergences the specification does not settle. Each entry names a scenario
and how the cross-check should compare it; every replayer reads this list
out of the corpus so all of them treat an open question the same way.
An entry is a question the specification leaves open, not a bug in any one
SDK. An entry is removed when the specification answers it, and the
comparison for that scenario goes back to strict.
The list is empty: the comparison is strict everywhere.
absent          the sequence of verdicts must match exactly
interleaving    each kind's subsequence must match in order, but the
interleaving between kinds is not compared
report          divergences are printed and do not fail the run
